subject: ARLO SEO — Weekly Pulse — 2026-09-18
html:
Weekly Pulse — Sept 18, 2026

~11 weeks since kickoff (2026-07-04). Shipped since last pulse (2026-09-11): the 2026-09-14 session fixed a dangling publisher @id reference in the connector-matrix JSON-LD (all 7 /connect/[slug] pages, now self-contained Organization nodes); the 2026-09-17 session found a fresh, sustained SE Ranking signal — google sheets alternative at 590/mo (KD 11), a step-change 5 months ago that has held every month since — and shipped a 5th destinations comparison section (/destinations/google_sheets), after the MCP-integration FOCUS cluster and all 8 catalog.ts-gated connectors were re-confirmed exhausted/blocked for a 6th straight session. This pulse re-confirms SE Ranking authenticated (4th consecutive live session) and pulls fresh data rather than reporting stale figures.

Leads proxy (GA4 conversions)

Pending — GA4 (G-CP22NBPLFP) is firing, but this sandbox still has no outbound GA4 API access. Waiting on the scheduled data Action (12-week-strategy.md Week 8) to backfill this row.

Ranking movement

Fresh live pull this session (PROJECT_getKeywordStats + PROJECT_getPositionHistory, 2026-09-11→2026-09-18, daily, site_id 12704162): average position flat at 100 (not-ranked floor) every single day. All 22 tracked keywords remain unranked, unchanged since tracking began 2026-07-04.

Traffic vs last week

Pending — no live GSC/GA4 API access in this sandbox (same blocker as every prior pulse). Site remains index_google: "1" (indexed) and domain_trust: 5, unchanged since 2026-09-01. Organic sessions are not yet measurable at this ranking stage (0/22 tracked keywords ranking, 0 site-wide organic keywords per DATA_getDomainKeywords as of the last check).

Anything broken?

No. Last 6 SEO Report Email workflow runs (09-04 through 09-17) all green, 38/38 all-time — no failures, no duplicate fires since the one-off 09-03 double-send. catalog.ts re-checked: all 8 gated connectors (meta_ads/linkedin_ads/meta_pages May 2026, tiktok_ads/stripe June 2026, hubspot/mailerlite July 2026, mailchimp August 2026) remain coming_soon and overdue, unchanged. Backlinks flat at 3 / 2 refdomains, unchanged since 2026-09-10. AI Result Tracker still has zero LLM engines configured on this project (PROJECT_listLlmEngines returns empty) — AI-visibility tracking itself is not yet wired up, so "AI-visibility movement" has no baseline to report against, separate from the "pending" GA4/GSC rows above.

Reading the week

Rank/backlinks/CI stayed exactly where they've sat for weeks — expected at DA 0, 11 weeks in, with off-page (0/6 listings) and GSC submission both still open and human-gated. The real story is the content engine: two genuine, previously-unflagged fixes shipped (a live structured-data defect on the site's core MCP-connector pages, and a real 590/mo commercial-intent term the static audits never named) instead of guessing at thin pages. The one open gap worth a human's attention: AI Result Tracker has no LLM engines configured, so this pulse still can't report actual AI-visibility movement — someone needs to set that up in SE Ranking before "AI-visibility" becomes more than a placeholder in this email.
